subject: Halcyon onboarding: DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list + PO routing
messages:
From: Ian Carter <ian.carter@halcyon-systems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, procurement@halcyon-systems.com
Cc: Marla Hughes <marla@hidalgolegal.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Halcyon onboarding paperwork — DPA + SOC2 + subprocessor list

Hi Evelyn,

We're getting ready to onboard Redwood as a supplier for our generative features pilot. Our procurement team needs the following to open a PO and complete vendor acceptance: DPA (signed or countersigned), a SOC 2 Type II report or a hosted link we can review, and your current subprocessor inventory.

Can you confirm:
- Do you accept eSign for the DPA (DocuSign/HelloSign)?
- Any special PO recipient or billing email we should use?
- Is there a public SOC 2 viewer link we can use rather than a full PDF?

Target timeline: we'd like to have the DPA signed and PO in place before Jan 12, 2028. Please advise if that looks feasible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if it's easier.

Ian Carter
Head of Procurement | Halcyon Systems
ian.carter@halcyon-systems.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: none

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ian Carter <ian.carter@halcyon-systems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Halcyon onboarding paperwork — DPA + SOC2 + subprocessor list

Hi Ian — thanks, and welcome. I've outlined the minimal items we need to move forward and attached the artifacts you asked for. Short answers up front: yes, we accept eSign (DocuSign link preferred); send PO to procurement@redwood.com and billing to billing@redwood.com.

Checklist / artifacts attached:
- Redwood_DPA-v3.pdf (attached) — our standard DPA; we can DocuSign it back to you.
- subprocessors_2027-12-14.xlsx (attached) — current list with hosting/CDN/cloud provider rows.
- SOC2 viewer link (below) — hosted report viewer with read-only access.
- PO-template-Redwood.pdf (attached) — example PO format to help your AP team.

SOC2 link (read-only): https://redwood-reports.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/typeii-2027/index.html
DocuSign prepare URL (internal): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef123456

Notes / required fields on the PO:
- Bill to: Redwood Inference, Attn: AP, billing@redwood.com
- Ship/Service to: Redwood Inference (no physical goods)
- Line item: "Inference API consumption - committed capacity" or a short description of services
- Please include Halcyon PO number on invoices and the HubSpot deal id: HAL-2027-934

If your legal team needs to redline the DPA, please send them to Rishi (cc'ed). Small heads-up: we prefer to keep data retention specifics aligned to the service description; if there's anything they push back on we'll propose narrow alternative language.

Timeline: if you can route the DPA for eSign by Dec 20 we can return it countersigned the same week and route the PO by Jan 5 to meet your Jan 12 go-live.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_DPA-v3.pdf (DPA template, 12 pages)
- subprocessors_2027-12-14.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
- PO-template-Redwood.pdf (sample PO, 1 page)

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Phone: +1 650-555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ian Carter <ian.carter@halcyon-systems.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Halcyon onboarding paperwork — DPA + SOC2 + subprocessor list

Ian / Evelyn — quick clarifying notes from our side for AP and legal so nothing trips on PO creation: 

1) Payment terms: our default is Net 30 from invoice receipt unless you have a different agreed term. If Halcyon requires Net 45 or other, list it explicitly on the PO.
2) Tax / remit: please include whether Halcyon requires any specific tax forms (W-9 equivalent) or withholding.
3) PO format: the PO-template we attached is what our finance system expects (PO number, vendor legal name, bill-to, remit). If your procurement system cannot import PDFs, we can accept a plain-text PO as long as it contains the fields above.

Rishi — looping you in for any DPA redlines. Per Evelyn: we do prefer narrow retention windows; if Halcyon legal proposes larger changes, please flag them so we can triage.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Ian Carter <ian.carter@halcyon-systems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@halcyon-systems.com, Marla Hughes <marla@hidalgolegal.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2027 11:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Halcyon onboarding paperwork — DPA + SOC2 + subprocessor list

Evelyn / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. A few quick confirmations: 

- We'll route the DPA through DocuSign today using the link you provided. Marla (cc'ed) will review Rishi's comments if any redlines come through.
- SOC2 link is accessible and sufficient for our security gate. Good to have the hosted viewer, that speeds the review.
- Subprocessor spreadsheet looks complete; our security team will follow up with one minor question about a CDN provider (they just want a region confirmation).

PO flow: we'll create PO HAL-2027-934 on our side and email the official PDF to procurement@redwood.com by next Tuesday (2027-12-21). Our AP will reference Net 30 unless billing requests otherwise. Once the DPA is eSigned both sides we expect to issue the first test invoice.

I'll share the DocuSign envelope id and the PO PDF when available. Appreciate the clear checklist — makes the gate much easier.

Regards,
Ian Carter
Head of Procurement | Halcyon Systems

Attachments (stubs):
- PO_HAL_934_stub.txt (internal PO id, will be replaced by official PDF)
- DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/details/abcdef67890
